title: Sorting with qsort
description:
Sort an array of structs several ways with function pointers.

```
by name:  Ada 36, Alan 41, Grace 85
by age, oldest first: Grace 85, Alan 41, Ada 36
by name length: Ada, Alan, Grace
```
hints: `const Person *x = a, *y = b; return strcmp(x->name, y->name);` (lesson 6.01).
For numbers, `(y->age > x->age) - (y->age < x->age)` sorts from oldest without the overflow risk of subtracting.
requirements: `typedef struct { const char *name; int age; } Person;`
Three comparison functions with the signature `int (*)(const void *, const void *)`.
A function `void print_people(const Person *p, size_t n)`.
stretch: Keep the comparisons in an array of function pointers and choose one with a number the user types.
